facts.fact: NITA-U is listed as responsible for VPN set-up, integration and production set-up, and support and maintenance of UgHub, the data integration platform hosted in the Government of Uganda data centre; dated by the page's publication date, 2025-06-19.
NITA-U runs UgHub, which the page says is fully operational and serves over 150 government entities (MDAs) with others onboarding; dated by the page's publication date, 2025-06-19.
